retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast sunset scene featuring a silhouetted parachutist against a massive yellow sun, framed by a top-left script logo and bottom-edge spaced typography.
triggerTerms: red sky with large yellow sun

recipe.visualDefinition: A dramatic landscape composition dominated by a deep red-to-black gradient sky, featuring a large, glowing yellow sun on the right side. A silhouetted figure hangs from a parachute in front of the sun, while a second, larger parachute canopy is visible in the upper right. The bottom third is a dark, silhouetted horizon line.
coreVisualRelationships: The large yellow sun acts as a backlight for the central parachutist.
The script logo in the top left balances the visual weight of the sun on the right.
The dark horizon at the bottom provides a stable base for the airy subject matter.
A diagonal vapor trail or light streak connects the dark left side to the sun.
coreInvariants: High-contrast silhouette against a saturated warm-tone gradient.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The sun is a large-scale element on the right; the parachutist is a small-scale focal point centered within the sun's glow.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large yellow sun on the right side.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top-left logo, down the diagonal light streak to the parachutist, then across the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark negative space in the upper left and lower horizon area.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep red and black gradient sky.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds and yellows with deep black values in the silhouettes.
paletteRestrictions: Warm tones only (red, orange, yellow, black).

letterConstructionRules: Top logo uses a flowing, connected script with a long decorative swash underlining the text.
Bottom text uses a clean, monolinear geometric sans-serif with extreme letter spacing.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' and 'S' in the script are oversized with elegant loops.
The underline swash tapers to a fine point.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a decorative, organic script with a rigid, spaced-out geometric sans.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the clean geometric base for the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast sunset photograph with a deep red sky, a large yellow sun on the right, and a black silhouetted horizon. Include a small silhouetted parachutist in front of the sun and a larger parachute canopy in the upper right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, golden-orange script logo in the top left with a long underline swash. Add all-caps white sans-serif text at the bottom with very wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the sun large and yellow?
Is the script logo in the top left?
Is the bottom text widely spaced?
Is the color palette restricted to warm tones and black?

postGenerationChecks: Check for smooth color gradients in the sky.
Ensure the parachutist is a sharp silhouette.
Verify the script swash does not obscure the main subject.
Confirm the bottom text is perfectly centered and legible.
recipe.reuseFormula: Dramatic sunset silhouette + script logo top-left + wide-spaced sans-serif bottom.
